about: Small signature things: each kind in one or two regions, no neighbour sharing it; bases from the load order (plugin:edid), placed by tools/newworld/dressing/place.py. sort: the Skyrim measure it is bounded by (skyrim_measures.json); per100: refs per 100 land cells of the region where its habitat holds; habitat: dressing habitat (place.py HABITATS). thing: the identity sheet's signature (newworld/sources/identity/regions.json) it delivers, or the lore line it rests on. A hanging kind (habitat 'hang') hangs from placed trees' hang points (hang_points.json) near settlements, roads' edges and Hist groves; its bound is the source mod's own rate (bound_per100, bound) where Skyrim has no measure.

glowing-fungi.thing: glowing fungi on fallen hardwood (arnesian-jungle sheet); luminous fungus of the bayou hummocks

hanging-hist-lanterns.bound: King of the Murkmire hangs 25 rope and paper lanterns in its 93 cells (at most 5 in a cell), none outdoors
hanging-hist-lanterns.thing: rope lanterns hung from the trees by the Hist-kin who tend them: Soulrest depends on the basin's Hist (banujha-basin present); the Hist pool at Jal-Veesa is the living shrine of barsaebica; wamasu organs are made into lanterns (story/lore/topics/loading-facts.md fact.wamasu-lanterns)
